physicalNotes: Radius 41.078 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 3179: radius 41.078 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 733.504 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.054) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 28,577,965 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4690 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 3179: effective temperature 4690 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.066) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
